request.style: English, bright female solo voice, piano, acoustic guitar, light drums, pizzicato strings, cello, curious and gentle mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Ahithophel the Gilonite left his home
To counsel the king who wore the crown
His words were weighed like the word of God
Esteemed by both David and Absalom

[Verse]
When the rebellion grew strong and deep
He joined the side of the rebellious heir
David fled on foot with his people
Praying for the Lord to break the scheme

[Chorus]
Turn Ahithophel's counsel into folly
Let the good advice be frustrated
For the Lord has ordained the outcome
And the plans of the wicked are scattered

[Verse]
He advised to take the concubines
To show the break was absolute and true
Then to strike by night with twelve thousand men
To catch the weary king in his flight

[Chorus]
Turn Ahithophel's counsel into folly
Let the good advice be frustrated
For the Lord has ordained the outcome
And the plans of the wicked are scattered

[Bridge]
But Hushai the Archite spoke with care
Saying the advice was not good
David is a warrior fierce and strong
He will not sleep with his troops

[Chorus]
Turn Ahithophel's counsel into folly
Let the good advice be frustrated
For the Lord has ordained the outcome
And the plans of the wicked are scattered

[Outro]
He saw his advice was rejected
And he returned to his home in Giloh
He set his house in order
And took his own life
